why: Read git show 2590111487 once, with FlowWorks RM_Patch_PawnFlyer_LandInPit (RM_PitPathing.cs:551). The break moves from the Normal-priority landing postfix to its own Priority.Last postfix on the same RespawnPawn; the FlowWorks postfix has no priority (Normal), so it now runs while the cover is whole, its IsOpenHole test is false, and the break then drops the pawn once. The flyer def test and TakeThrow are kept, so another mod's flyer never breaks a cover and one throw breaks at most one. Nothing that followed the break in the old postfix used its result. Before/after test selftest_explosiveknockback_landing_cover_order.py run by me: rc 1 on 2590111487^ and on 092b2e358b, rc 0 at the fix; it reads source order only, so the behaviour rests on the live check: sc_pit_fall solo lane descents=2 in 3 of 3 runs before (evidence/sc_pit_fall_before_fix.txt), descents=1 on the fixed build (evidence/sc_pit_fall_p2.txt), FAIL on the planted kept cover (evidence/sc_pit_fall_plantA2.txt). One changed case, harmless: after a rail puts a thrown pawn back, the cover test reads the cell it was put on.
